title: Jingulu language
description: Endangered Mirndi language spoken in Australia
extract: Jingulu, also spelt Djingili, is an Australian language spoken by the Jingili people in the Northern Territory of Australia, historically around the township of Elliot. The language is an isolate branch of the Mirndi languages.
